## How to sign

When you open your first pull request, the CLA bot posts a comment. Reply with exactly:

> I have read the ServerOS CLA and I agree to its terms

The bot records your GitHub username, the date and the pull request, and marks the check as passed. Questions about the CLA: [liam@serveros.com](mailto:liam@serveros.com).
